def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    # mapping of directives to regex
    mapping = {
        '%Y': r'\d{4}',
        '%y': r'\d{2}',
        '%m': r'\d{2}',
        '%b': r'(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)',
        '%B': r'(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)',
        '%d': r'\d{2}',
        '%e': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%H': r'\d{2}',
        '%I': r'\d{2}',
        '%p': r'(AM|PM)',
        '%M': r'\d{2}',
        '%S': r'\d{2}',
        '%f': r'\d{1,6}',
        '%z': r'([+-]\d{4}|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})',
        '%Z': r'\w+',
        # maybe others
    }
    # iterate
    i=0
    regex_parts=[]
    while i < len(fmt):
        if fmt[i] == '%':
            # look ahead
            if i+1 < len(fmt):
                directive = fmt[i:i+2]
                if directive in mapping:
                    regex_parts.append(mapping[directive])
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    # unknown directive: treat as literal %
                    regex_parts.append(re.escape('%'))
                    i += 1
                    continue
            else:
                regex_parts.append(re.escape('%'))
                i += 1
        else:
            # accumulate literal until next %
            start=i
            while i < len(fmt) and fmt[i] != '%':
                i+=1
            literal = fmt[start:i]
            regex_parts.append(re.escape(literal))
    return ''.join(regex_parts)
